purpose: Continue own-weight training through measurement repair, one equal-work learning-rate comparison, then one separately approved continuation.

recipe.training_data: Same native TinyStories stream and tokenizer; no new admissions

phases.name: Repair and validate measurement
scope: New version of joint-tokenized option scorer; exact continuation spans
One consistent deadline schema and mocked contract test for every phase
Read-only BF16 and independent FP32 fixed loss/option scores for steps1745 and2889
Freeze40new development prefixes in20families,20balanced grading anchors, rubric and decision rules before new model outputs
Generate40baseline continuations; two blinded grading orders containing40baseline+20anchors each
Corrected empty/shuffled-passage controls for both saved checkpoints; report diagnostic accuracy without requiring current capability
Independent CPU scorer fixtures for target shift, continuation-only loss, causal masks and source/clock contracts before model execution
pass_all: All600candidate token sequences match intended full-text encoding; prefix spans and equal lengths verified
Independent FP32/native NLL absolute difference <=0.02 on131072targets for both saved checkpoints
Zero checkpoint mutation, optimizer updates or changed training inputs
Each grader request passes>=9of10positive and>=9of10negative anchors; anchor inter-review kappa>=0.6
Across40actual baseline continuations, binary repeat agreement>=85percent and mean absolute total-score difference<=1.0of10
New probe prefixes<=96native tokens;96token output windows fit current256context; all probes/anchors are development material, not independent acceptance

phases.name: Equal-work training comparison
phases.prerequisite: R0 passed and owner reviewed results

arms.start: Same step2889 full state including moments and RNG
arms.data: Exactly the same next256updates as A

eligibility_all: Native fixed NLL improves>=0.01nats from R0step2889baseline
Corrected grounded accuracy loses<=5of100 from R0baseline
Distinct grammar accuracy loses<=2of45 from R0baseline
Within each paired teacher request, story mean loses<=0.25of10 vs baseline and incoherent-sentence rate rises<=10percentagepoints
Exact CPU save/reload, independent saved-checkpoint FP32 parity and all resource checks pass
At least one behavioral gain vs baseline: corrected grounding improves>=5of100, OR paired story mean improves>=0.25of10 in each of the two teacher reviews; lower loss alone never releases R2
phases.selection_rule: If exactly one arm eligible, select it. If both eligible, select B only if NLL_B<=NLL_A-0.01 and B loses<=5grounded cases and<=2distinct grammar pairs vs A; otherwise select A and label cooldown advantage unproven. Neither eligible:stop, noR2.

phases.name: Bounded continuation of selected own checkpoint
phases.prerequisite: R1eligible winner reviewed and explicitly approved
phases.source: Chosen R1step3145 checkpoint; preserve optimizer, RNG and data cursor
phases.learning_rate_if_B: Hold0.00005; no reheating or warmup reset
phases.teacher_case_composition: 100current original-packet stories+40current new probes+40selected-R1probe outputs+20anchors; two independently permuted requests
development_success_all: Corrected original grammar>=75of100 and distinct correct>=max(36, selected-R1distinct correct)
Original100story conservative primary-and-both-teacher pass count>=20; no replacement of historical failed scores
On40paired new probes, mean two-review total improves>=0.5of10 from selectedR1;20-family10000-resample bootstrap95percent lower bound>0
Primary/both-teacher binary kappa>=0.6 on original100cases and teacher repeat agreement>=85percent; undefined disagreement statistics are inconclusive, not a pass
Degeneration<=5of100 under unchanged narrow rule; grading-anchor checks and all correctness/resource checks pass
Corrected intact-passage accuracy beats both empty and shuffled controls by>=15percentagepoints

totals.earlier_feasibility_and_benchmark_ledger: Preserved separately; combined number is not lifetime-project total

teacher.interface: Codex CLI with existing ChatGPT login
teacher.identity_disclosure: Record requested identity; do not claim backend-resolved identity unless returned
teacher.usage_enforcement: Use provider-side output controls when exposed; audit observed usage after every response and halt dispatch on any cap breach. Never claim that post-response observed-token checks can prevent already incurred usage.

guards.consecutive_training_loss_spike_stop: 3updates each>1.5times first16update mean; first16updates abort if loss>2times phase-source fixed NLL
guards.any_technical_arm_failure: Terminal for the entire phase; do not rescue it by selecting the completed other arm

authority.phase_clock: Starts at that phase explicit approval; never resets; report wall time including setup/evaluation. Inter-phase owner wait has no workers and is recorded separately.
authority.source_freeze: Freeze phase source manifest, evaluation cases and activation receipt before model execution; one shared clock schema for every reader.

after_R2.if_pass: Report development progress, not formal English acceptance. Prepare separate foundation-to-conversation readiness proposal; current English gate or an explicitly approved replacement/exception must be resolved before any SFT.
after_R2.if_fail: Stop this15Mdelivery path under this resolution budget; preserve all artifacts. No automatic TinyStories extension, new architecture or data switch. A separately justified under100Mdata/architecture/compute proposal may follow; no claim of mathematical infeasibility.
after_R2.conversation: New separate bounded SFT proposal using retokenized and re-reviewed curriculum with fresh family-heldout cases; GPT-6Sol teacher only under a new allowance.
after_R2.tools: Only after conversation acceptance; separate internal/MCP schema, argument, permission and result-grounding evaluations. Runtime tool execution is separate from learned student competence.

implementation_preparation.shared_runtime: One shared runner/scorer/clock schema for this new version; parameterized phases, not copied per-stage programs
implementation_preparation.CPU_preparation: Routine CPU-only edits/tests allowed before source freeze, inside the phase preparation allowance; no new student lineage
implementation_preparation.model_attempt: One model-executing attempt per phase after source/receipt/evaluation freeze; any post-launch correctness/resource/deadline stop is terminal
